meta.name: imagegen-frontend-web
meta.description: Elite frontend image-direction skill for generating premium, conversion-aware website design references. CRITICAL OUTPUT RULE — generate ONE separate horizontal image FOR EVERY section. A landing page with 8 sections produces 8 images. Never compress multiple sections into one image. Enforces composition variety (not always left-text / right-image), background-image freedom, varied CTAs, varied hero scales (giant / mid / mini minimalist), narrative concept spine, second-read moments, and a single consistent palette across all images. Optimized for landing pages, marketing sites, and product comps that developers or coding models can accurately recreate.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为网站每个区块生成高质量设计参考图
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要为网站每个区块生成风格统一的设计参考图
copy.tagline_en: Generate high-quality design reference images for each website section
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need design reference images for each section of a website

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会为网页的每个模块分别生成一张独立的横向设计参考图。它会刻意避开常见的千篇一律排版（比如总是左文右图），而是根据内容变化构图、背景、按钮样式等，让每张图都有清晰可参考的界面结构。
howto.when: 当用户要求为落地页、营销网站或产品页面创建设计参考图，或说“landing page”“full website template”等词时触发。未指定区块数时默认生成 6 或 8 张图。

say.text: 帮我做一个落地页设计参考图，按 6 个板块各出 1 张横图。
say.note: 会得到 6 张独立的横向参考图。

say.text: 为这个 SaaS 首页生成 8 张分区参考图，每张布局要不同。
say.note: 会按多变的构图分别出图。

say.text: 设计极简风格的营销页，每个区块单独出一张图。
say.note: 会以极简风格逐段出图。

howto.what_en: Claude generates one separate horizontal design reference image per webpage section, deliberately varying composition, backgrounds, and CTAs instead of using repetitive left-text/right-image layouts, giving developers a clear codeable UI reference.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks for design references for landing pages, marketing sites, or product pages, or says 'landing page' or 'full website template'. Without a section count, it defaults to 6 or 8 images.

say_en.text: Make a landing page design reference with 6 horizontal images, one per section.
For this SaaS homepage, make 8 section images with varied layouts.
say_en.note: It will output each with a different composition.

say_en.text: Design a minimalist marketing page, one image per section.
say_en.note: It will render each section in a minimalist style.
